words.trans: 一丝不苟地、极其仔细严谨地（出于原则规矩、谨小慎微、不敢有半分疏漏）
examples: He had always been scrupulously careful to avoid encounters with manned aircraft.

words.trans: 有人机/机上载有飞行员的飞行器
examples: He had always been scrupulously careful to avoid encounters with manned aircraft.

words.trans: 避开、远离、不要靠近（= get clear of）
examples: He knew how to stay clear of the RAF's Hawks and Texans practising low-level flying.

words.trans: 留意、提防、当心
examples: Watching out for Typhoons blasting up the valleys was all part of the thrill.

words.trans: n. 兴奋、激动、快感；v. 使非常兴奋（自带"刺激感"）
examples: Watching out for Typhoons blasting up the valleys was all part of the thrill.

words.trans: …的正常内容、都是…的一部分（虽有点麻烦/奇怪但本属整体，不必大惊小怪；all part of the game/growing up）
examples: Watching out for Typhoons blasting up the valleys was all part of the thrill.

words.trans: 抢先一步、比某人先做到（争夺同一机会/物品时更快）
examples: He had to find the drone first, before someone beat him to it.

words.trans: 令人窒息的、喘不过气；（环境）空气不流通、闷热憋闷、胸口发闷
examples: It was like the suffocating feeling he had in small spaces.

words.trans: 逼近、围拢；（白天）变短（the world would close in）
examples: It seemed the world would close in and crush him.

words.trans: （车辆）靠边停车、（火车轮船）到站进站；吸引（顾客/观众）；逮捕带走问话；（口语）赚取大钱
examples: Just then a Volvo estate pulled in outside the house.

words.trans: 陷入停滞、完全停止（原本运行的事物突然停下）
examples: The girl shot out before the car had even come to a standstill.

words.trans: 迅速射出、突然冲出、喷出（快得像子弹"嗖"地出去）
examples: The girl he had seen on the hilltop shot out of the car.

words.word: stand like a rabbit caught in headlights
words.trans: 像被车灯照到的兔子一样僵在原地（因极度震惊、恐惧而不知所措、一动不动）
examples: He stood like a rabbit caught in headlights while Aunt Emily greeted the new arrivals.

words.trans: 走过去、到…那边去
examples: He stood frozen while Aunt Emily went over to the new arrivals.

words.trans: 就在那时、正好那时（强调两动作同时发生，带巧合/突然意味）
examples: But just then a Volvo estate pulled in.

words.trans: 喜欢户外活动的、热爱大自然的、有户外风格的
examples: The man looked like the kind of outdoorsy type they always had staying in summer.

words.trans: 用大拇指猛地朝…一指
examples: He jerked a thumb towards the house. 'Lovely place you've got here!'

words.trans: = you have；口语倒装【形+名】+ you've got（Lovely place you've got here! 你这儿地方真好）
examples: Lovely place you've got here!

words.trans: 费力的、艰苦的、需要很大体力/精力的
examples: He turned away and began the strenuous thirty-yard journey down to the river.

words.trans: 加快速度、加快步伐（也可比喻工作/事情提速）
examples: He picked up the pace, his walking stick like a third leg.

words.trans: （因失衡、恐慌或无力而）乱挥、乱蹬、胡乱挣扎
examples: His walking stick flailed beside him on the path.

words.trans: 侄孙、外甥孙
examples: And that's Thomas, my great-nephew.

words.trans: 沉溺于、陷入、完全放纵于（放任自己、不再克制）
examples: He carried on, abandoning himself, in his hurry, to his trademark gait.

words.trans: 步态、走路的样子（特有的姿势或节奏）
examples: He carried on in what was now his trademark gait.

words.trans: 下垂、低垂、耷拉（花/叶/眼皮/嘴角因疲惫失去力量垂下）
examples: His walk had a whole-body droop to the right.

words.trans: 抽搐的、痉挛的、剧烈的（身体不受控制的抽动，或强烈的反应）
examples: His gait ended in a convulsive shake with each step.

words.trans: 得了较厉害的某种病/严重陷入某种状态（a bad case of nerves 紧张得不行）
examples: He walked like someone with a bad case of pins and needles.

words.trans: 手脚发麻、像无数小针扎皮肤（久坐、压到肢体后的麻刺感，固定复数）
examples: His leg felt like someone getting up with a bad case of pins and needles.

words.trans: （尤指小动物或小孩）轻快地跑、蹦蹦跳跳地跑（活泼、轻快、略慌忙）
examples: There was the sound of scampering on the gravel behind him.

words.trans: 碎石、砂砾（常铺在路上或院子里）
examples: There was the sound of scampering on the gravel behind him.

words.trans: 可怜的、悲惨的、糟糕透顶的（语气很重）
examples: Suddenly the wretched dog was at his feet.

words.trans: 被…绊倒
examples: He tripped over the dog and fell into a puddle.

words.trans: 脸朝下摔在地上；引申为彻底失败、出丑
examples: He tripped and fell flat on his face into the only remaining puddle.

words.trans: 恶意的、怀有恶意的
examples: The way she laughed wasn't malicious; she just smiled innocently.

words.trans: 皱眉、怒视、愁眉苦脸（n./v.）
examples: Despite his scowl, she held her hand out to help him up.

words.trans: 费力地把自己撑起来/站起来（语气比 pull oneself up 更吃力）
examples: He pushed the dog away and hoist himself to his feet with a growl.

words.trans: 未被吓倒的、不屈不挠的
examples: 'I'm sorry, he must like your smell,' the girl said, undaunted.

words.trans: 糊满泥的、泥巴结在身上的
examples: Tom's arms were caked in mud from the fall.

words.trans: （液体、气体）缓慢地渗出、渗透、漏出（强调缓慢透过细小缝隙）
examples: He could feel moisture seeping through his shorts.

words.trans: 撕掉、扯掉；（口语）敲竹杠、宰客（a total rip-off）
examples: The blue button had ripped off his shirt when he fell.

words.trans: 在…方面很差劲
examples: I'm rubbish at sewing, but I can do buttons.

words.trans: 起水泡的；酷热的、猛烈的
examples: He was too blistering with embarrassment to hear what she said.

words.trans: 用力投掷、猛扔（比 throw 更用力更猛烈）
examples: He climbed into Maggot and hurled his stick to the floor.

words.trans: （语气、笑容中的）锋芒、尖锐感（edge to one's voice 语气带锋芒；razor-edge 更如刀锋般锐利）
examples: There was a razor edge to her voice.

words.trans: 主动想办法帮人解围、给台阶、给一线生机
examples: He knew this was Aunt Emily's way of throwing him a lifeline.

words.trans: 使某人免于、免遭某事
examples: It was a way of saving him from humiliating himself even more.

words.trans: 让自己丢人、出丑、自取难堪
examples: She saved him from humiliating himself even more.

words.trans: 使窒息、闷死、透不过气（物理或比喻环境/关系令人压抑）
examples: The cabin filled with smoke and he feared he would suffocate if he stayed.
